record.paper_title: Open Problems for Entire Functions of Bounded Index in Direction
record.original_question: Let L be a positive continuous function in the class Q_b^n, meaning that along every complex line z + tb in direction b the ratios L(z+tb)/L(z+t0 b) are bounded above and below away from 0 on scaled discs |t-t0| <= eta/L(z+t0 b), uniformly in z and t0 for each eta. For an entire function F on C^n, is bounded L-index in direction b equivalent to the following single-scale maximum-minimum condition: there exist R > 0, P2(R) >= 1, and eta(R) in (0,R) such that for every z0 in C^n and t0 in C, some r in [eta(R),R] satisfies max{|F(z0+tb)| : |t-t0| = r/L(z0+t0 b)} <= P2(R) min{|F(z0+tb)| : |t-t0| = r/L(z0+t0 b)}?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $b\in\mathbb{C}^n\setminus\{0\}$ be a fixed direction. Denote by $Q_b^n$ the class of positive continuous functions $L\colon \mathbb{C}^n\to(0,\infty)$ satisfying the following regularity along every complex line in direction $b$: for every $\eta>0$ there exists $\lambda(\eta)\geq 1$ such that
$$\lambda(\eta)^{-1}\;\leq\;\frac{L(z+tb)}{L(z+t_0 b)}\;\leq\;\lambda(\eta)$$
for all $z\in\mathbb{C}^n$, all $t_0\in\mathbb{C}$, and all $t\in\mathbb{C}$ with $|t-t_0|\leq \eta/L(z+t_0 b)$.

An entire function $F\colon\mathbb{C}^n\to\mathbb{C}$ is said to have bounded $L$-index in the direction $b$ if there exists $N\in\mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}$ such that for every $z\in\mathbb{C}^n$ and every $m\in\mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}$,
$$\frac{|\partial_b^m F(z)|}{m!\,L(z)^m}\;\leq\;\max_{0\leq k\leq N}\frac{|\partial_b^k F(z)|}{k!\,L(z)^k},$$
where $\partial_b F(z)=\sum_{j=1}^n b_j\,\partial F/\partial z_j$ and $\partial_b^m$ denotes its $m$-th iterate.

Question: Is it true that an entire function $F$ on $\mathbb{C}^n$ has bounded $L$-index in the direction $b$ if and only if there exist constants $R>0$, $P_2(R)\geq 1$, and $\eta(R)\in(0,R)$ such that for every $z_0\in\mathbb{C}^n$ and every $t_0\in\mathbb{C}$ there exists $r\in[\eta(R),R]$ with
$$\max\bigl\{|F(z_0+tb)|:|t-t_0|=r/L(z_0+t_0 b)\bigr\}\;\leq\;P_2(R)\,\min\bigl\{|F(z_0+tb)|:|t-t_0|=r/L(z_0+t_0 b)\bigr\}\,?$$
artifact.category_tag: Entire functions of bounded L-index in direction
artifact.status_search_result: Search located related work by Bandura, Skaskiv and collaborators establishing maximum-modulus and minimum-modulus criteria for boundedness of L-index in a direction, including in slice-holomorphic settings. However, no source explicitly resolving this particular single-scale max/min equivalence (with $r$ allowed to vary in $[\eta(R),R]$) was identified, so the status appears to remain open or at least unverified.

status_evidence.title: Some criteria of boundedness of the L-index in direction for slice holomorphic functions
status_evidence.snippet: Criteria describing local behavior of maximum and minimum moduli of slice holomorphic functions on slice circles.
status_evidence.claim: Related max/min criteria exist, but not exactly the single-scale form posed.

status_evidence.title: Slice Holomorphic Functions in Several Variables with Bounded L-Index in Direction
status_evidence.snippet: Local behavior criteria for maximum and minimum modulus of slice holomorphic functions of bounded L-index in direction.
status_evidence.claim: Investigations in this direction are ongoing in the Bandura-Skaskiv program.
